description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for processing streams of lines, including filtering, stopping at specific patterns, skipping prefixes, and handling repeated or timed lines, used in a code completion or text processing context.

methods.name: avoidPathLine
methods.description: Filters out lines starting with a specific comment pattern indicating echoed paths.

methods.name: avoidEmptyComments
methods.description: Filters out lines that are empty comments.

methods.name: streamWithNewLines
methods.description: Inserts newline characters between streamed lines.

methods.name: stopAtSimilarLine
methods.description: Streams lines until a line similar to a target line is encountered, then calls fullStop.

methods.name: stopAtLines
methods.description: Streams lines until any of the specified stop phrases are found in a valid context, then calls fullStop.

methods.name: stopAtLinesExact
methods.description: Streams lines until an exact stop line is encountered, then calls fullStop.

methods.name: skipPrefixes
methods.description: Removes configured prefixes from the first line of the stream.

methods.name: stopAtRepeatingLines
methods.description: Streams lines until a line repeats three times consecutively, then calls fullStop.

methods.name: showWhateverWeHaveAtXMs
methods.description: Streams lines until a timeout occurs after some content has been streamed.

methods.name: noDoubleNewLine
methods.description: Streams lines until a blank line appears after some content, then stops.
